may would you pray with me Heavenly Father we pray that you would help us be salt and
light to a world enslaved to its passions, its pride, and its rebellion against you.
Father, we confess we know what it feels like to live in rebellion against you.
We know all too well.
Our hearts are quick to wander to the kingdom of this world, the kingdom of self, rather
than to submit ourselves to your kingdom and your righteousness.
So Lord, forgive us.
Have mercy on us.
May your will be done on earth and in our hearts as it is in heaven.
And come quickly Lord Jesus.
Bring your kingdom and all its fullness, joy and flourishing soon we pray.
Help us to press on until that day when our faith becomes sight.
Help us to be emboldened by your kingdom blessing through your spirit to withstand insults and
persecution.
Help us to fear you more than we fear man.
We thank you for Jesus who forgives us when we fail.
We trust in Him and not in our own efforts.
We pray all this in Jesus name. Amen.
